explanation_short: The analysis confirms that the inclusion of all 11 features maximizes the predictive power, with KNN achieving the highest R² score of 0.8179.
explanation_full: The comprehensive analysis, combining feature ranking and incremental testing, strongly indicates that the model's predictive capability is maximized when all 11 features are utilized. The table shows that the KNN model's R² score rises steadily, culminating at 0.8179 with the full feature set. This superior performance, compared to models using subsets of features, underscores that the combination of VFA, Butyrate, Acetate, VSS, Propionate, Ethanol, COD-O, pH, ORP_Low, ORP_Mid, and Sucrose_Degradation provides the most complete picture for predicting HPR.
